calls.thesis: Reiterated BUY (prior BUY 10 Oct): calls Hims & Hers extremely undervalued and a potential 100x over 10-20 years, despite the stock down 38% over the past year and 8.2% in the past month. Five reasons: a huge US pharma market ($400-800B), market leadership (51% of observed telehealth sales, 48.5% of customers vs Ro/Roman ~23-25%), expanding specialties (dermatology, mental health, hormone health, weight loss, now testosterone/TRT), international expansion (Germany, Canada, Australia via Eucalyptus, Japan potential), and peptides as a new leg (in-house compounding facility, HHS draft interim policy opening BPC-157/TB500, modelled at $180M at 100k subscribers, $1.8B at 1M).
calls.price_at_call: ~$6.4B market cap; ~$2.6B revenue, H2 2026 guidance +50% YoY
calls.base_case: Revenue grows toward $5-6B in a couple of years on peptides plus organic/GLP-1 momentum, justifying a much higher multiple than near-1x sales.
calls.bull_case: 100x over 10-20 years if it becomes a top-2/3 player in a massive disrupted market.
calls.bear_case: International expansion adds execution risk for management; peptides still need final rules written; Q3 earnings due 9 Nov are the near-term catalyst.

calls.thesis: GLP-1 compounding disruption settled (Novo/Eli Lilly products now on platform); guidance of 50% revenue growth in H2 2026 after Eucalyptus/Zava acquisitions; EV/sales ~2.8 with a ~$400B+ pharma TAM to attack.
